regions.name: The Wardens' Lodge
regions.blurb: Rangers and wardens who live in the great oaks and patrol the forest roads.

regions.name: The Coven
regions.blurb: The witches' home: candles, cauldrons, thorns, and the things they stitch and brew.

regions.name: The Hushwood
regions.blurb: The oldest part of the forest, home to fae, dryads and the wyrmblood.

regions.name: The Mistway
regions.blurb: Rivers, bogs and the grey coast: ferrymen, tollkeepers and things that drowned.

regions.name: The Hanging City
regions.blurb: A timber city built on stilts, with its guilds, garrison, tradespeople and theatre.

regions.name: The Ossuary
regions.blurb: The bone lands under the giant skull, home to the dead and the debt collectors.

regions.name: The Frostfell
regions.blurb: The frozen north: ice, raiders and the wyrm.

regions.name: The Ironmarch
regions.blurb: Forges and gunpowder: smiths, cannons and coal.

regions.name: The Far Shores
regions.blurb: A country across the sea. Only a few of its people have come to the forest so far: a spearman, a masked watcher and a writer of a script nobody here can read.

regions.name: The Lantern Isles
regions.blurb: Shrine bells, paper lanterns, wandering swordsmen and the curses that follow them.

regions.name: The Rooftops
regions.blurb: Schoolkids in uniform who were given powers they didn't ask for.

regions.name: The Neon Sprawl
regions.blurb: A neon city of mech pilots, androids and a cybernetic oni, plus the tinkerer who repairs them.

regions.name: The Starlit Court
regions.blurb: Magical girls, mascots and a demon lord.

regions.name: The Fallen Sky
regions.blurb: Beings that fell from the night sky, made of feathers, glass or starlight. They belong to no kingdom.

regions.name: The Risen Deep
regions.blurb: Creatures from deep underground, out of black water and underground fire.

regions.name: The Rootdark
regions.blurb: Things that grew in the dark: a talking fungus, a hive and its queen, a walking hill, a skull-headed marsh and a moth.
